result:
I'd make people better at changing their minds. If everyone could update their beliefs when shown good evidence, without feeling like they'd lost something, then a lot of other problems would get easier to solve.

I'm tempted to pick something more concrete, like ending extreme poverty or disease. But so many of the world's problems persist not because solutions don't exist, but because we're bad at agreeing on what's true, admitting mistakes, and changing course. Policies that don't work stay in place because reversing them feels like defeat. Conflicts drag on because backing down means losing face. A world where "I was wrong about that" was easy to say, even admired, would be better at fixing everything else.

What would you change?
